name: nihil.
source:
The year is 2189. You are aboard the interplanetary ship “Sunday,” exploring distant star systems in search of a new home for humanity. As a cartographer’s assistant, your maps guide the crew through alien worlds – and perhaps toward secrets that were never meant to be found.

[From [url=https://mike-starrow.itch.io/nihil]Itch.io[/url]]
